source: Look of the recoloured car materials, shared by the garage (garage_scene.gd) and the drive (vehicle_visual.gd) through game/scripts/car_materials.gd. Roles come from the material name: paint*, rim*; glass = a transparent material whose name contains one of glass.match and none of glass.exclude. paint_tinted* keeps its albedo texture (an atlas whose paint area is white) and multiplies it by the paint colour; every other paint/rim material drops its texture. Values are art choices [AS]: metallic flake paint under a clear coat, polished alloy rims, smooth window glass.
